text: She had her first son, wrapped him up, and laid him in a feed trough, because there was no room for them anywhere else.
The one who made the stars had nowhere to lay his head the very night he arrived.
The hands that shaped the mountains were small enough to curl around a mother's finger.
He did not come down halfway.
He came all the way down, to the bottom, to the people the world had no space for.
